cloudflared: In software.yml (the Cloudflare Tunnel daemon) but installed via a custom method with no package-manager provider column, so gen-catalog.mjs skips it (providerless entries are not browseable). Configured by post-cloudflared.sh; intentionally not in the App Store catalog.
cua-driver: Internal desktop automation driver and MCP registration hook (post-cua-driver.sh) installed automatically on desktop hosts via the official cua.ai installer; not a standalone user-browseable catalog app.
firewall: Internal OS-native Zero-Trust firewall and DOCKER-USER ingress protection hook (post-firewall.sh); part of host security provisioning rather than a browseable user application.
ntfy: In software.yml (the ntfy pub-sub notification service) but installed via a custom method with no package-manager provider column, so gen-catalog.mjs skips it (providerless entries are not browseable). Configured by post-ntfy.sh; intentionally not in the App Store catalog.
nvidia-toolkit: Internal capability-gated NVIDIA Container Toolkit and CDI specification hook (post-nvidia-toolkit.sh) for Linux GPU container hosts; infrastructure runtime plumbing rather than a browseable catalog app.
github-runner: Internal CI self-hosted-runner enrollment hook (post-github-runner.sh). Not in software.yml and not a user-facing installable application — it configures a runner on an already-provisioned host, so it is intentionally not browseable.
github-runners: Internal multi-runner GitHub Actions self-hosted runner fleet enrollment hook (post-github-runners.sh). Infrastructure provisioning hook rather than a user-browseable catalog application.
zsh-bootstrap: Internal shell bootstrap (post-zsh-bootstrap.sh) that seeds zsh/zinit config. Not in software.yml and not a user-facing installable application — it is part of provisioning, not a catalog tool, so it is intentionally not browseable.
